fixture_policy: Public fixtures must be synthetic. Private, licensed, customer, and held-out fixtures remain outside Git and are referenced by immutable digest.

workloads.title: Deterministic invoice CSV to managed report
workloads.oracle: Parsed totals, artifact bytes, version metadata, workflow state, and one effect receipt match deterministic expectations.
workloads.limitations: Current Python result is reference-development evidence and does not prove a production service or model.

workloads.title: Authorized local file to artifact through generic typed DAG
workloads.oracle: Every step has typed input/output, current policy and lease identity, durable cancellation/recovery state, immutable output, and an effect receipt.
blockers: end-to-end integration of the reference DAG and broker with the MVP workflow

workloads.title: Compact 4-6B candidate comparison A
workloads.oracle: The exact signed pack/runtime tuple completes the common OS-task set offline with correctness, resource, latency, cancellation, and recovery evidence.

workloads.title: Compact 4-6B candidate comparison B
workloads.oracle: Uses the identical task set, measurement method, context, and reporting fields as WL-003.

workloads.title: Mainstream comparison candidate on common OS tasks
workloads.oracle: Results use the same task definitions and disclose any hardware/runtime differences rather than normalizing them away.

workloads.title: Real 400-405B placement and load experiment
workloads.oracle: Real model weights are placed or a measured blocking constraint is retained; sparse mappings, fake tensors, smaller models, and vendor capacity statements are rejected as success.
required_evidence: load result or measured blocking constraint

workloads.title: Pinned Qwen3-1.7B local inference integration smoke
workloads.oracle: The pinned loopback runtime returns the exact requested marker, reports measured completion tokens, remains local-only, and the Luma adapter binds the result to a current resource lease without marking it simulated.
required_evidence: loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint through the Luma lease-fenced adapter
workloads.limitations: Development smoke only. The model is 1.7B, both profiles share one physical laptop, WSL is not native Ubuntu certification, and this workload does not replace the governed 4-6B comparison or real 400-405B experiment.
